description: This Java class, ProductImagesController, manages product images in an e-commerce admin web application. It provides endpoints for listing, paginating, saving, and deleting product images, handling validation, security, and image processing.

classes.name: ProductImagesController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller handling product image management for admin functions, including listing, uploading, and deleting images.

methods.name: displayProductImages
methods.description: Renders the product images management page for a specified product, verifying store permissions.

methods.name: pageProductImages
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to retrieve paginated product images for display.

methods.name: saveProductImages
methods.description: Processes uploaded images for a product, saving them to the database.

methods.name: deleteImage
methods.description: Removes a specified product image via AJAX call, verifying permissions.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up menu context attributes for rendering views.
